add.title: ModuleMove plan/apply is slow: Files.move.test takes 86s, past the runner's 60s timeout
add.why: A move_plan reads ~39,500 files (public, Server, Servex, .claude, no `worktrees` skip) and takes several seconds per call; Files.move.test.mjs makes ~15 and now needs 86s (it passed only after its 4s answer limit became 30s). The runner reports TIME every full run. Fix: cache the file list/contents per plan→apply, skip dated records earlier, or give the test a longer per-file timeout in TestRunner.

add.title: Files.move.test fails with EPERM from a worktree (2026-11-02)
add.why: run-all from the test-browser worktree: Files.move.test.mjs failed after 64 s, move_apply EPERM then ENOENT on a prompt-tasks-test file; earlier runs only timed out. Look at Socket.js:65 and the temp fixture.

add.title: Start every worktree dev server with NO_PAGEFILES=1 (worktree-up.mjs and worktree-restart.mjs)
add.why: 2026-11-02, item-phase1: a worktree's own server rewrites files.jsonl in its tree. That leaves noise in every worktree, makes merge.mjs refuse a dirty tree, and broke Server/plugins/SocketServer/Files.move.test.mjs in the merge gate (EPERM/EEXIST inside the test's own folders); restarting the worktree server with NO_PAGEFILES=1 cured it. The main tree's server writes the real index lines after a merge anyway. Related: the 2026-11-02 Files.move EPERM entry above; ModuleMove.plan now skips a vanished file (83d87119b).
